policy: Exact, issue-linked, identity-pinned exceptions to the CI axiom audit (QBP #827; director ruling, option (a); identity pins per PR #829 Red Team finding 3). Each entry names ONE fully qualified declaration, its MODULE and a FINGERPRINT (SHA-256 of the canonical serialisation the Lean auditor computes: the constant's statement/body plus every project constant it reaches), and for EACH excepted axiom its exact name, module and fingerprint, plus the open issue that owns it. A declaration is allowed only if name, module and fingerprint match AND its non-standard axioms are EXACTLY the entry's, each with matching module and fingerprint. The pins are identity checks only; no axiom name decides pass or fail. Any other non-standard axiom fails the gate; an entry whose declaration is not reported, or no longer matches, is STALE and fails, so the entry must be deleted when its issue lands (or re-pinned after review — never widened). No wildcards, prefixes or per-file entries. A Lean toolchain bump that renumbers the native axiom, or any edit to a project constant the theorem reaches, makes the entry stale on purpose: re-check it.
